integrity: All-length calculation is analytical; finite verification is bounded, exhaustive only for n<=5. Scientific review is same-model only, with independent audit outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Complete nonpositive sign classification only through binary order four; for all higher orders only an explicit positive family is proved. General joint-moment methods are prior literature, not new. Earlier equivalent sign laws not categorically excluded.
title: The first positive local-selector correlation in binary de Bruijn cycles
